question: Which narrow user job earns the mandatory cozy multiplayer house and can be fully delivered in a two-week owner-led build?
type: Qualitative evidence-backed positioning comparison,not human A/B or causal experiment
researchBeforeProtocol: Four exploratory lanes generated competitor/paper/candidate/scope evidence; their initial recommendations are not scored evaluation trials.

A.job: Begin and close one personally chosen study task alongside known friends
A.target: 2-6 university friends with overlapping evening work time
A.loop: join,greet,declare optional next small step,sit,work,leave a next-step note
A.board: one current goal and next-step card per resident
A.roomPurpose: recognisable personal corner and voluntary retreat

B.job: When stuck,find a willing familiar peer without summoning busy friends and preserve a next step
B.target: 2-6 already-known university friends taking same/related courses,overlapping evening self-study
B.loop: join,set own availability,work,post concise question,volunteer offers,chat,author records next step
B.board: one goal/question/next-step card with optional offer per resident
B.roomPurpose: personal corner and selective visits;door access distinct from availability

C.job: Get one actionable piece of feedback from trusted friends on a work-in-progress
C.target: 2-6 student creators/creative coding friends who already exchange drafts
C.loop: join,share external artifact link and specific question,invite visit,chat,record revision

D.job: Let familiar distant friends encounter each other without arranging a call
D.target: 2-6 friends with evening overlap who want casual company while doing their own work
D.loop: drop in,walk/greet,talk/quiet retreat,leave a small note,return

rubric: specific observable user job and trigger
every mandatory feature has a plausible role without forced hoops
honest differentiation against closest well-configured alternatives
bounded implementation and integration cost in 14 days
falsifiable user value and feasible access to target users
ongoing upkeep without expanding into a platform
rating: Supported / plausible but unvalidated / weak; concise reasons,no invented probability or weighted score
reviewers: Two fresh fork_turns=none evaluators,opposite candidate presentation order,same owner brief/source dossier/budget. No parent recommendation or chat history.
stopping: One initial independent pass per reviewer,parent resolution of material contradictions,one bounded refinement pass if revisions require it. No repetition for artificial agreement.

humanComparison.comparison: Chosen house task flow vs a well-configured private Discord text channel with status convention and one pinned goal/help message/thread
humanComparison.sharedTask: Identify a willing partner,raise a brief question,have a short conversation,preserve/retrieve a next step while one friend stays quiet
humanComparison.scope: Two or three existing-friend pairs/groups, counterbalanced order,one bounded session per condition and a next-day return if possible
record: reasoned choice to reuse or prefer baseline
humanComparison.limits: Small qualitative pilot; no productivity,grades,wellbeing or statistical preferenceclaim
falsifiers: people do not return except when prompted
